## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` — tests are documentation).
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` all pass locally.
- [ ] If user-facing: a changeset was added (`pnpm changeset`).
- [ ] If a new dependency was added: justified below (bundle size is a feature).
- [ ] Conventional commit message used for the squash title.
